description: Hand-coded set for the sentiment flagger (section 11a: evaluate against a hand-coded set before enabling). Each case is one person's answers; `expected_markers` lists markers that must appear at least once with confidence >= 0.5 and `forbidden_markers` lists markers that must not appear at confidence >= 0.5.

answers.question_text: One of you wants to reorganize a shared space the other uses. What's the right way to go about it?
answers.answer_text: He would never reorganize anything, he is far too lazy to notice a mess exists. Honestly he is useless around the house and always has been. I roll my eyes and do it myself.

answers.question_text: On the tasks that flagged, describe the split you'd actually be content with.
answers.answer_text: I would be content if he did the dishes twice a week, which he did on Tuesday and Thursday last week, so maybe it is possible.

answers.question_text: One of you says something hurtful in a fight. Ten minutes later, what happens? The next morning?
answers.answer_text: I go to the garage and I do not talk to her for the rest of the night, sometimes the next day too. There is no point. Whatever she says I am the problem, so I just shut it down.

answers.question_text: What does a pause in a fight mean to you, and what would make you trust that it isn't abandonment?
answers.answer_text: It is not my fault she gets like that. If she brought things up normally I would not have to leave. She started it every single time last month, I only ever react.

answers.question_text: What's the smallest thing your partner could do that would make you feel wanted this week?
answers.answer_text: She brought me coffee in bed on Sunday, but I know she only did it because she wanted something. When she says she loves me it is usually because she feels guilty about something.

answers.question_text: Your partner has been quiet for two days. What do you assume, and what do you do?
answers.answer_text: I assume work is heavy. On Wednesday I made her tea and asked if she wanted company or quiet, and she picked quiet, so I read next to her.

answers.question_text: When you're upset, how do you want to be approached, in words you'd actually use?
answers.answer_text: 'I noticed you seem low. I am here when you want me.' Then a bit of space. That is what she did last Friday and it worked.

answers.question_text: On the tasks that flagged, describe the split you'd actually be content with.
answers.answer_text: The bins went out late three times last month and we got a notice. I would like the bins to be his on Sunday nights and the recycling mine on Wednesdays.
